description: This file defines the 'Expression' class, a part of the Conditional Formatting Wizard system in PhpSpreadsheet, used to create and manipulate conditional formatting rules based on formulas or expressions within spreadsheets.

classes.name: Expression
classes.description: Represents a conditional formatting expression wizard that allows creating, manipulating, and retrieving conditional formatting rules based on expressions or formulas within a spreadsheet cell range.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Expression wizard with a specific cell range.

methods.name: expression
methods.description: Sets the expression for the conditional formatting rule after validating it.

methods.name: getConditional
methods.description: Builds and returns a Conditional object configured with the expression and style details.

methods.name: fromConditional
methods.description: Creates an Expression wizard instance from an existing Conditional object.

methods.name: __call
methods.description: Handles dynamic method calls, specifically intercepting calls to 'formula' to set the expression.
